rule.any: There are some coins in a heap, of value 1, 2, or 3 pengő. In a move, the player may take a coin from the heap and put back a coin of smaller value in its place, or nothing. The winner is the one who takes the last coin from the heap.
rule.fixed: There are three 1-pengő, five 2-pengő, and seven 3-pengő coins in a heap. In a move, the player takes a coin from the heap and puts back a coin of smaller value in its place, or nothing. The winner is the one who takes the last coin from the heap.

step.placeBack: Choose an option in the place back bar.
step.take: Click a coin to remove it.
